## Analyzing NOAA Data Across New York State

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
data("ny_noaa")

ny_noaa_df = 
  ny_noaa |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date, label = TRUE),
    prcp = prcp / 10,
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10) |>
  filter(year >= 2001)

set.seed(1)

ny_noaa_sample =
  ny_noaa_df |>
  slice_sample(n = 3000)
```

## Plotly Scatterplot

```{r}
ny_noaa_sample |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmax, y = ~tmin, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", color = ~month, alpha = 0.5)
```
